preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t consist only of lowercase English letters.
Both strings s and t are non-empty.
The length of each string does not exceed 2·10^5.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Yes' if all(any(i == k[j] for j in range(len(t)) if (k := [s.index(t[m], i) for m in range(len(t)) if s[i:] and s[i:].startswith(t[m:])]) and len(k) == len(t)) for i in range(len(s))) else 'No'
postconditions.description: The output is 'Yes' if and only if every character in s is part of at least one subsequence of s that matches t exactly, otherwise 'No'.
